title: Add Completed library filter
summary: Adds a read-only Library filter to Completed Current Output Status and exposes completed manifest library metadata in the Completed row DTO.
reason: Operators need to narrow the current completed-output review table by source library without changing backend manifest, publish, rerun, cleanup, or media policy scope.
behavior_before: Current Output Status could be filtered by text, status, and investigation view only. Completed row DTOs did not expose library_id or library_name for display filters.
behavior_after: Current Output Status includes a dynamically populated Library select sourced from backend completed-row library metadata. Filter summaries, selected-row visibility, and acceptance-scope evidence show the active library filter as display-only context.
